question: 围绕“有限上下文或有限搜索预算下如何保留必要证据”，比较 G-Retriever、Tree-of-Traversals 与 CuriousLLM 的机制。哪些是子图选择，哪些是搜索边界，哪些是证据缺口信号？
answer: 在有限预算下保留证据的机制比较中，Tree-of-Traversals 明确维护并反复扩展一个局部 KG 子图，直到该子图包含回答所需信息，并在 LLM 能用该局部子图作答时停止 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]；这属于子图选择，同时其树搜索组件定义了搜索轨迹、回溯和终止条件，因而也是搜索边界 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。CuriousLLM 用预设 passage budget K 约束遍历，并在遍历代理返回空集合时终止循环 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]；它还训练模型在证据足够时生成终止信号，从而提前结束搜索 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。因此 CuriousLLM 的预算与终止机制属于搜索边界，其“证据足够”终止信号可视为证据缺口关闭信号，但其子图选择流程在给定引文中证据不足 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。G-Retriever 的机制证据在给定引文中不足：现有引文只有结果表和效率表附近文字，无法据表推断其检索流程或子图选择机制 [chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。

Tree-of-Traversals
The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local
KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it
contains all the information required by an LLM
to answer the given query. At the start, a local
KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities
present in the original query. It is then expanded
using a tree search algorithm to choose actions and
thoughts generated by an LLM in order to obtain
relevant knowledge from the KG using a KG inter-
face. The algorithm halts when the LLM is able
to answer the original query using the local KG
subgraph as context.

Tree-of-Traversals consists of
three major components. (1) A knowledge graph
interface implemented to interact with one or more
required KGs. (2) An action state machine (ASM)
which is a finite state machine that defines the fea-
sible space of actions, states, and prompt templates
when the LLM interacts with a KG to expand the
local KG subgraph. (3) A tree search algorithm
which defines the overall LLM search trajectory
such as best first search, backtrack upon making a
mistake, and termination condition when an answer
is found.

Our evaluation of early traversal termination using
the CuriousLLM agent demonstrates substantial
improvements in efficiency while maintaining com-
petitive accuracy in MD-QA tasks. Our mistral
model, fine-tuned to generate a termination signal
("NA") when it has gathered sufficient evidence,
significantly reduces traversal time without com-
promising the quality of the final answer. This
early termination feature allows the agent to stop
the search process as soon as necessary information
is identified, thus minimizing unnecessary compu-
tation and latency.
We compare three different agents: Mistral with
early termination (Mistral-ET), the standard Mis-
tral without early termination, and the T5 model.
